compile_all_chstone_benchmarks: compile all CHStone C benchmarks to LLVM bitcode in parallel using CHStoneDataset.compile_all
get_chstone_benchmark_uris: get all CHStone benchmark URIs by calling CHStoneDataset.benchmark_uris to iterate over the suite
load_chstone_benchmark_from_uri: load a CHStone benchmark from a parsed URI using CHStoneDataset.benchmark_from_parsed_uri with on-demand compilation
check_chstone_dataset_size: check the number of benchmarks in the CHStone dataset using the CHStoneDataset.size property
create_chstone_dataset_instance: create a CHStoneDataset instance with a site_data_base Path to initialize the benchmark suite
